### C-7A.6 — R4 — Meaning from wide context
Stamp: DECIDED-2026-09-25    Source: FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]

ALONE
- What it is: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Meaning depends on wide accumulated context rather than the local words. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]
- Takes in: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Each statement and the largest accumulated context available. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]
- Does: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Reads each statement against the largest accumulated context available. The same words can mean different things across accumulated context: “I'm done with this” can be a claim, an expression, a joke, a callback or an intention, visible only against a wide frame built across many sentences. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]
- Gives out: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Any reading produced without available wide context, or with thin wide context, is low-confidence by default. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]
- Must never: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Classify from the words directly in front of the reader, substitute the local line for wide context, or pretend to certainty that thin context cannot support. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]
- Fails closed by: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — For any reading produced when wide context is unavailable or thin, defaults to low-confidence and says so. FR-0158 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 4 — MEANING COMES FROM WIDE CONTEXT, NOT LOCAL WORDS]

ALONE
- What it is: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — The structure may grow in every direction in principle but is deliberately limited in practice. FR-0156 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 10 — MAXIMAL-BUT-BOUNDED]
- Takes in: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — The breadth and depth of the meaning structure. FR-0156 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 10 — MAXIMAL-BUT-BOUNDED]
- Does: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Extends width and depth only as far as actually usable by a tired human, then draws a real chosen line: “The most a human can actually use, then a line.” The line is a design choice and may move outward over time as Ness becomes better at navigating the structure. FR-0156 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 10 — MAXIMAL-BUT-BOUNDED]

- Must never: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Be infinite: an infinite structure is harder to sort into than reading raw text and becomes a second thing to organize. Be rigid: a fixed list misrepresents how meaning works. Silently expand past the current line. ALONE
- What it is: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — System descriptions distinguish an architecture-and-safety contribution from claims of changed cognition. FR-0157 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 12 — HONESTY ABOUT WHAT THIS IS]
- Takes in: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — A description of N.H to Ness or anyone else. FR-0157 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 12 — HONESTY ABOUT WHAT THIS IS]
- Does: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — May truthfully describe “a structured place for the AI to be creative (chat) without that creativity corrupting what's permanent (memory)”: the contribution is where things are allowed to happen. The model underneath is unchanged. FR-0157 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 12 — HONESTY ABOUT WHAT THIS IS]
- Gives out: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — An accurate account of the architecture and its safety boundary. FR-0157 [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_Universal_Filter_RULES.md §RULE 12 — HONESTY ABOUT WHAT THIS IS]
- Must never: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — Claim this “makes the AI think independently” or is “a new kind of cognition”. ### C-7B.2.8.3 — Whole-work and sentence scope
Stamp: DECIDED-2026-09-25    Source: [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]

ALONE
- What it is: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — FR-0119: the full restored scope of mode on a composed work and reading of its sentences. [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]
- Takes in: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — FR-0119: composed works (story/article/poem/document, authored by Ness or obtained from the internet) and conversational turns. [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]
- Does: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — FR-0119: **RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE.** Root distinction: *why it was said*, not surface form, not true/false. Candidate root types (~7, not final): state/claim · ask · wonder · express/feel · intend · report · imagine — these are the **intent** web. **MODE / REGISTER is a SEPARATE PEER WEB, orthogonal to intent**: a piece has BOTH an intent AND a form. Mode reads **what form the piece was made in** — a composed WORK (story / article / poem / document, Ness-authored or pulled from the internet) vs a conversational TURN — and produces a **name** (document/story/article/poem/turn) as a **reading, not a stamp** (revisable, R5; accretes, R6). The name sits on the **whole work** (the `re_reads` span); each sentence inside is still individually read by EVERY web (a story is NOT exempted or gated — R1). Mode's output **combines** with the other webs (§7B Part 3), never overrides them: "despair expressed *inside a story*," not "Ness despairs." Whose work it is = **deixis** (author = who), not mode. Forms are a **small open set**, grows by need. [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]
- Gives out: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — FR-0119: a revisable form-name on the whole work, combined with readings of its sentences across all webs. [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]
- Must never: DECIDED-2026-09-25 — FR-0119: exempt a story from any web, let mode override another dimension, assign authorship through mode, or seal the form-name. [05/NH_DECISION_RECORD_PRE_V10_RECOVERY_BUCKETS_2026-09-25_v0_2_CANDIDATE.md §4 / Group 9] [98/sources/NH_MASTER-11.md §7A / RULE 9 — HOW THE FILTER SORTS: BY MEANING-TYPE, IN A GROWING STRUCTURE]

### C-7B.7.1 — Hold-versus-reading policy
Stamp: ACCEPTED    Source: [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]

ALONE
- What it is: ACCEPTED — The fork between useful waiting and the honest insufficient-context outcome. [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]
- Takes in: ACCEPTED — A responsible-read failure already established by the owning acceptance machinery, together with what is missing and whether it can plausibly arrive. [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]
- Does: ACCEPTED — Hold only if a specific missing condition is recordable and realistically obtainable later. Otherwise produce the separate honest `insufficient_context` reading through the existing reading machinery. The substantive grounded-enough threshold is not selected by this policy. [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]
- Gives out: ACCEPTED — Either a legitimate waiting condition or a valid completed, revisable reading that honestly records insufficient context. [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]
- Must never: ACCEPTED — Infer insufficiency from rejection count; create an indefinite hold with no useful condition; reinterpret a rejected proposal as the fallback reading. [04/NH_A29_HOLD_UNTIL_ENOUGH_POLICY_v1_0_CANDIDATE.md §2]
